get.description: Returns every application on the mesh, including inactive ones. The public catalog only exposes active applications.

post.description: Registers a new application. The slug must match the certificate CN of the service's mesh nodes.
Query applications with text search over name and slug, status faceting, date-range filters, sorting, and pagination. An empty body returns page 1, size 25, sorted updated_at desc, unfiltered.

get.description: Fetches a single application by ID, including its current status.

patch.description: Updates an application's name and status. Set status to 'inactive' to soft-disable it — there is no hard delete.

get.summary: List user grants for an application in a tenant
get.description: Returns the per-user grants for an application within a tenant. Pass tenant_id as a query parameter.

post.summary: Grant a user access to an application
post.description: Grants a user access to an application within a tenant, with explicit roles/scopes and an optional tier. Explicit scopes are admin-assigned; tier scopes are inherited.

delete.description: Removes a user's access to an application within a tenant.

patch.description: Replaces a grant's roles and scopes and sets (or clears) its tier.

get.summary: List tenants licensed for an application
get.description: Returns the tenants authorized to use an application.

post.summary: Authorize a tenant for an application
post.description: Licenses a tenant to use the application. A user cannot be granted access in a tenant that is not licensed.

delete.summary: Revoke a tenant's license for an application
delete.description: Removes a tenant's authorization to use the application.

get.description: Returns the scope catalog defined for an application.

post.description: Adds a scope to an application's catalog. Scopes are opaque permission strings the application interprets itself.

delete.description: Removes a scope from the catalog. Any tier features referencing it are cascaded automatically.

get.description: Returns the subscription tiers defined for an application, ordered by rank.

post.description: Adds a subscription tier to an application. Bundle scopes into it via its features.

delete.description: Removes a tier. Its feature bundles are cascaded; grants that referenced it keep their explicit scopes.

get.summary: List scopes bundled into a tier
get.description: Returns the scopes bundled into a tier — the features every subscriber on this tier inherits.

post.summary: Bundle a scope into a tier
post.description: Adds a scope to a tier's bundle. Users on the tier inherit it immediately — scope composition is dynamic.

delete.summary: Unbundle a scope from a tier
delete.description: Removes a scope from a tier's bundle.

get.description: Returns the external identity providers janus supports for account linking.
Returns a paginated list of all tenants. Use limit and offset to page.

post.description: Query tenants with text search over name and slug, status faceting, date-range filters, sorting, and pagination. An empty body returns page 1, size 25, sorted updated_at desc, unfiltered.

get.description: Fetches a single tenant by ID.

patch.description: Updates a tenant's name and status. Set status to 'suspended' to disable it.

get.description: Returns the members of a tenant with their roles, paginated.

post.description: Adds a user to a tenant with a role (viewer, editor, admin, or owner).

delete.description: Removes a user from a tenant. Removing the last owner is rejected.

patch.description: Changes a member's role within a tenant. Demoting the last owner is rejected.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of users. Pass email to look up a single user by address.

post.description: Creates a user directly. Normally users are provisioned automatically via the OIDC login flow.
Query users with text search over email and display name, status faceting, date-range filters, sorting, and pagination. An empty body returns page 1, size 25, sorted updated_at desc, unfiltered.

get.description: Fetches a single user by ID.

patch.description: Updates a user's display name and status. Set status to 'inactive' to disable the account.

get.description: Returns the external identity-provider accounts linked to a user.

delete.description: Removes a linked external account from a user.

get.description: Returns the active sessions for a user.

delete.summary: Revoke all of a user's sessions
delete.description: Revokes every active session for a user and returns the count revoked.
Revokes a single session by ID.
